titles.english: The Secrets of Star Divine Arts

description:
Chen Xing is the young master of the Chen family in Dongyang City. Orphaned at a young age, he was slated to inherit the position of head of the family upon coming of age, but was plotted against and nearly assassinated by the ambitious acting head, Chen Sheng, who schemed to usurp his position. Surprisingly, Chen Xing survives the ordeal and accidentally obtains the long-lost supreme technique, "Ancient Astral God Art."

(Source: Youku, translated)
